comments.author: Jafar
comments.body:
if you are a crafter and plan to make a bunch and sell, then it is better to craft it yourself. Otherwise is not worth to spend a day to make it.
you need to get a teak plating. There are 2 ways to get it: (1) buy from ports in red sea/india. (2) get a recipe from aden, then use lumbers+irons to make it.
then turn the teak plating to Hardened teak plating with coal (recipe from Bergen).
Then get Antifouling paint (even harder to make - gonna spend you another day, or 2-3m from company/bazaar). Then proceed the final step at 1 of the cities shown above..
You can easily earn 5m 10m in 30 mins from noob dungeons.
